parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
Under certain conditions, the distance s moved in a straight line by an object in time t is given
by
s = (1)/(2)at^{2}
where a is the acceleration of the object.
State two conditions under which the above expression applies to the motion of the object.
parts.question_text_latex:
Under certain conditions, the distance s moved in a straight line by an object in time t is given
by
$s = \frac{1}{2}at^{2}$
where a is the acceleration of the object.
State two conditions under which the above expression applies to the motion of the object.
